title: Document locked by previous user, cannot check in updated version
description: A colleague checked out a policy document last Thursday before going on leave. We need to upload the reviewed version urgently but the document is locked. The colleague is not reachable until next week.

worklogs.description: Identified the locked document in ACCE. Confirmed it is checked out by user ekilic.
Verified with manager that the colleague is on approved leave and the cancellation is authorized.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I can see the document is checked out by ekilic. In FileNet, an administrator can cancel a checkout which effectively releases the lock, but any changes the user had made locally will be lost since they have not checked them in. Before I proceed, could you confirm with the user's manager that it is acceptable to lose any local edits the user may have made? This is a required authorization step.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Confirmed with the manager Selin Arslan - she authorized the cancellation. The colleague had only made minor formatting changes that are not needed.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Thank you for the confirmation. I will now cancel the checkout and release the document lock. This will make the document available for you to check out and upload the new version. Give me just a minute.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Cancelled checkout via ACCE > navigate to document > Reservation > Cancel Checkout. Confirmed the document is now in Checked In state.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The lock has been removed. You can now check out the document and upload the reviewed version. Let me know if you need any help with the check-in process.
